If q(n)=q(n′), then n′⁻¹n∈I, so the value is independent of the representative. It is a homomorphism and is continuous by the quotient topology; surjectivity of q proves uniqueness. If p:E→G additionally satisfies pφ=q, then p barφ q=q, hence p barφ=id_G and barφ is a section.
